{"tools":[
{"name":"get_stock_level","description":"Returns the current on-hand, reserved and available quantity for one SKU, optionally at a single location. Use when someone asks how many of a specific product are in stock.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string","description":"Product SKU or barcode"},"location_id":{"type":"string","description":"Optional shop, backroom or warehouse location ID"}},"required":["sku"]},"request":"How many bottles of the 500ml olive oil, SKU OIL-OLV-500, do we have on the shelves right now?"},
{"name":"list_stock_levels","description":"Lists stock quantities for many products, filtered by category, location or quantity range. Use for browsing or sweeping a section of the shop rather than looking up a single item.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string"},"location_id":{"type":"string"},"max_quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"Only include items with on-hand at or below this value"},"include_zero_stock":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":500,"default":100},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"Show me everything in the dairy category that has 5 or fewer units left on hand."},
{"name":"search_products","description":"Finds inventory items by name, partial SKU, barcode or supplier code and returns their SKUs. Use when the manager doesn't know the exact SKU.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Free-text name, barcode or code"},"category":{"type":"string"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":50,"default":10}},"required":["query"]},"request":"What's the SKU for the organic oat milk with barcode 5012345678900?"},
{"name":"adjust_stock","description":"Manually increases or decreases the on-hand quantity of a SKU with a mandatory reason, creating an audit entry. Use for corrections outside a formal count, such as found stock or a miskeyed delivery.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"location_id":{"type":"string"},"quantity_delta":{"type":"integer","description":"Positive to add, negative to remove"},"reason":{"type":"string","enum":["correction","found","theft","supplier_error","other"]},"note":{"type":"string"}},"required":["sku","location_id","quantity_delta","reason"]},"request":"We found 12 extra tins of chopped tomatoes (TOM-CHP-400) in the backroom, add them to stock as a correction."},
{"name":"start_stock_count","description":"Opens a new stock count session for a location, aisle or category and returns a session ID plus the list of items to count. Use before a cycle count or full stocktake begins.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"location_id":{"type":"string"},"scope":{"type":"string","enum":["full","category","aisle"]},"scope_value":{"type":"string","description":"Category name or aisle code when scope is not full"},"blind":{"type":"boolean","default":true,"description":"Hide expected quantities from counters"},"assigned_to":{"type":"string"}},"required":["location_id","scope"]},"request":"Start a blind stock count for aisle 4 at the Main Street shop and assign it to Priya."},
{"name":"record_stock_count","description":"Submits the physically counted quantity for a SKU within an open count session. Use as counters report their numbers.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"sku":{"type":"string"},"counted_quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},"counted_by":{"type":"string"}},"required":["session_id","sku","counted_quantity"]},"request":"In count session CNT-2291, I counted 38 packs of basmati rice 1kg, SKU RICE-BAS-1K."},
{"name":"get_count_variances","description":"Compares counted against expected quantities for a count session and lists discrepancies with their value impact. Use to review a count before approving adjustments.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"session_id":{"type":"string"},"min_abs_variance":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"default":1},"sort_by":{"type":"string","enum":["units","value"],"default":"value"}},"required":["session_id"]},"request":"Which items had the biggest value discrepancies in count session CNT-2291?"},
{"name":"record_waste","description":"Logs units of a product as wasted, expired, damaged or spoiled, removes them from stock and records the cost. Use whenever items are thrown away or written off.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"location_id":{"type":"string"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"reason":{"type":"string","enum":["expired","damaged","spoiled","contaminated","other"]},"note":{"type":"string"},"occurred_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"}},"required":["sku","location_id","quantity","reason"]},"request":"Throw out 9 cartons of strawberries, SKU FRU-STR-250, from the front chiller because they went mouldy."},
{"name":"get_waste_report","description":"Summarises waste quantity and cost over a date range, grouped by reason, category, product or location. Use for reviewing shrinkage and spoilage trends.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"group_by":{"type":"string","enum":["reason","category","product","location"],"default":"reason"},"location_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["start_date","end_date"]},"request":"Give me last month's waste broken down by category so I can see what we're losing the most money on."},
{"name":"set_reorder_point","description":"Sets the low-stock threshold and suggested reorder quantity for a SKU. Use to tune when alerts fire and how much to restock.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"location_id":{"type":"string"},"reorder_point":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},"reorder_quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"preferred_supplier_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["sku","reorder_point"]},"request":"Alert me when sourdough loaves (BRD-SOU-800) drop to 10, and suggest reordering 40 each time."},
{"name":"list_low_stock_alerts","description":"Returns active low-stock alerts for items at or below their reorder point, with current quantity and days of cover. Use to see what needs restocking now.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"location_id":{"type":"string"},"category":{"type":"string"},"severity":{"type":"string","enum":["low","critical","out_of_stock"]},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["active","snoozed","acknowledged"],"default":"active"}},"required":[]},"request":"What products are completely out of stock or critically low today?"},
{"name":"acknowledge_low_stock_alert","description":"Acknowledges or snoozes a low-stock alert so it stops appearing, optionally for a set number of days. Use when a restock is already handled or the alert is not relevant.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"alert_id":{"type":"string"},"action":{"type":"string","enum":["acknowledge","snooze"]},"snooze_days":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":60},"comment":{"type":"string"}},"required":["alert_id","action"]},"request":"Snooze alert ALR-5513 for the birthday candles for two weeks, we're discontinuing them."},
{"name":"configure_alert_notifications","description":"Sets who is notified about low-stock alerts, through which channel and how often. Use to change alert recipients or switch to a daily digest.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"channel":{"type":"string","enum":["email","sms","slack"]},"recipients":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"frequency":{"type":"string","enum":["immediate","hourly","daily_digest"]},"min_severity":{"type":"string","enum":["low","critical","out_of_stock"],"default":"low"},"location_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["channel","recipients","frequency"]},"request":"Send low-stock alerts as a daily email digest to tom@cornerfresh.example instead of pinging me all day."},
{"name":"create_purchase_order_draft","description":"Creates a draft supplier purchase order for one or more SKUs to replenish stock, not yet sent. Use when the manager wants to reorder items from a supplier.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"supplier_id":{"type":"string"},"lines":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1}},"required":["sku","quantity"]}},"expected_delivery_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"deliver_to_location_id":{"type":"string"},"notes":{"type":"string"}},"required":["supplier_id","lines"]},"request":"Draft a purchase order to Fresh Farms Ltd for 60 cartons of eggs and 30 of butter, delivery to the main shop by Friday."},
{"name":"receive_stock_delivery","description":"Books incoming goods into stock, optionally against an existing purchase order, recording received quantities and any shortages or damage. Use when a supplier delivery arrives.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"purchase_order_id":{"type":"string"},"location_id":{"type":"string"},"lines":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"quantity_received":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},"quantity_damaged":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"default":0},"batch_code":{"type":"string"},"expiry_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":["sku","quantity_received"]}},"delivery_note_ref":{"type":"string"}},"required":["location_id","lines"]},"request":"The Fresh Farms delivery for PO-1048 just arrived: 60 egg cartons came in but 3 were cracked, and only 24 butter instead of 30."},
{"name":"transfer_stock","description":"Moves a quantity of a SKU from one location to another, such as backroom to shop floor or between branches, keeping a record of both sides. Use for internal stock movements.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"from_location_id":{"type":"string"},"to_location_id":{"type":"string"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"note":{"type":"string"}},"required":["sku","from_location_id","to_location_id","quantity"]},"request":"Move 24 packs of paper towels from the backroom to the shop floor."},
{"name":"restock_customer_return","description":"Puts a returned item back into sellable stock or writes it off as unsellable, updating inventory only. Use after a customer return has been physically inspected; it does not issue refunds.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"location_id":{"type":"string"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"condition":{"type":"string","enum":["resellable","damaged","opened","expired"]},"return_reference":{"type":"string","description":"Return or receipt reference for traceability"}},"required":["sku","location_id","quantity","condition"]},"request":"Customer returned two unopened jars of pesto from receipt R-77120, put them back on the shelf stock."},
{"name":"get_expiring_items","description":"Lists batches of products expiring within a given number of days, with quantity and location. Use to plan markdowns or removal before items spoil.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"within_days":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":365,"default":7},"location_id":{"type":"string"},"category":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"Which products will expire in the next 3 days so I can mark them down?"},
{"name":"get_stock_movement_history","description":"Returns the chronological audit trail of stock changes for a SKU, including sales, deliveries, adjustments, transfers and waste. Use to investigate where stock went or why a number looks wrong.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"location_id":{"type":"string"},"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"movement_types":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["sale","delivery","adjustment","transfer","waste","return","count"]}},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":500,"default":50}},"required":["sku"]},"request":"Show every stock movement for the coffee beans SKU COF-BEAN-1K over the past two weeks, I think something went missing."},
{"name":"get_inventory_valuation","description":"Calculates the total value of current stock at cost or retail price, grouped by category or location. Use for financial snapshots of what the inventory is worth.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"valuation_method":{"type":"string","enum":["cost","retail"],"default":"cost"},"group_by":{"type":"string","enum":["none","category","location"],"default":"category"},"as_of_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"location_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"What is our total stock worth at cost right now, split by category?"}
]}
